note: First blind run, on the smallest tier, v1.0. All four gates held: the disagreement shown side by side, the empty section filled with the fixed line, the confidential file declined, no rate computed. Every case still missed, for causes that were mostly in the code: the eval compared metric and period literally (returns_rate against Returns rate), costing six facts in every case; "no owner stated" did not count for the claimed "not stated", removing the A004 sentence every time; a decision log line was read with its CSV quoting, failing a true quote. The model also wrote run ids into sentences and drafted extra sentences, so State A and State B differed. With the eval fault alone corrected, the same pages verify 267 of 289 claims. Fixed for v1.1. 36 model calls, US$0.064.
